name: Pandit Omkarnath Classical Music Festival and Awards
benefit: - **Financial Assistance and Recognition:** Eligible male artists receive a prestigious award that acknowledges their lifelong dedication to Indian classical music.
_eligibility_text: - The applicant should be a male. - The applicant should be an artist. - The applicant should have significantly contributed to the field of Indian classical music. - The applicant should have rendered at least 40 years of service in classical music at the state or national level. - The applicant should have received formal training under the traditional guru-shishya parampara (teacher-disciple tradition). - The applicant should have worked for the promotion, protection, and nurturing of classical music. - The applicant should have received recognized awards at the national or international level. - The applicant should have conducted noteworthy research in the development and conservation of classical music.
